{{Youmay|the [[Signal Intelligence]] agent|[[Gav Daragon]]}}
'''Gav''' was an operative in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Signal Intelligence]] division who [[Jonas Balkar]] used as a contact. Balkar told [[Aric Jorgan]] to contact Gav in his search for the [[Deadeyes]], but [[Zane (SIS)|Zane]] intercepted his call.
